summary: This bill prohibits the Department of Homeland Security from spending federal funds on or using full-body restraints, defined as four-point and five-point restraints that immobilize an individual, and requires the removal of any employee who violates this prohibition or deceives Congress about it.

scores.thoughts: This bill prohibits the Department of Homeland Security from using full-body restraints. While it does not directly address immigration policy, it mandates reporting on the citizenship or immigration status of individuals subjected to such restraints if a violation occurs. This tangential connection to the treatment of individuals who may be immigrants, within the context of DHS operations, gives it a minor, indirect bearing on the topic.
